title: Smart Title Case
description:
Convert the string `"the lord of the rings"` to title case (capitalize the first letter of every word), but keep small words like `a`, `of`, `the`, `and`, `in`, `on` in lowercase UNLESS they are the first word. Print the result.

**Expected output:**
```
The Lord of the Rings
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
title = "the lord of the rings"
hint: Split the title, capitalize the first word always, then for the rest capitalize only if not in the small-words list.
